title: post api auth login with valid credentials
description: Verify that users can successfully sign in with valid email and password credentials via POST /api/auth/login.

title: post api auth signup with new account details
description: Verify that users can create a new vault account by submitting valid email and password via POST /api/auth/signup.

title: put api auth profile to complete first time profile setup
description: Verify that authenticated users can complete their profile setup by submitting full name, optional phone number, and avatar photo via PUT /api/auth/profile.

title: post api pin create to setup 4 digit security pin
description: Verify that authenticated users can set up a 4-digit security PIN by submitting matching PIN entries via POST /api/pin/create, and receive success confirmation.

title: get api vault items to browse and search vault items
description: Verify that authenticated users can retrieve and filter vault items by category and search terms via GET /api/vault/items, and see correct filtered results.

title: post api vault items to add new document item
description: Verify that authenticated users can add a new document item to the vault by uploading a file via POST /api/vault/items and receive a celebratory success popup.

title: post api vault credentials to add new password credential
description: Verify that authenticated users can add a new password credential to the vault by submitting generated or entered password via POST /api/vault/credentials and receive a celebratory success popup.

title: post api vault items id unlock to decrypt locked item
description: Verify that authenticated users can unlock a locked vault item by submitting the correct 4-digit PIN via POST /api/vault/items/:id/unlock and view decrypted sensitive details.

title: post api pin verify to enforce pin verification and lockout
description: Verify that the system enforces PIN verification via POST /api/pin/verify, locks out users for 30 seconds after 5 consecutive failed attempts, and prevents further unlock attempts during lockout.
